data.title: Ethereum ETFs lose $103M as Bitcoin ETFs gain $... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) saw $103.3 million in outflows on October 19, led by BlackRock's ETHA, while Bitcoin ETFs attracted $526.7 million, highlighting a strong investor preference for Bitcoin over Ethereum. This outflow trend has pushed Ethereum's price below $2,500, with a potential downside risk to $2,300 before the Federal Reserve's policy decision on October 28. Despite weak institutional demand, Bitmine Immersion Technologies continues accumulating Ethereum, holding over 6 million ETH tokens. The market remains sensitive to macroeconomic factors, and Ethereum's price could either recover to $2,500 or fall further depending on ETF flows and Fed policy outcomes.
data.author: Coinpaper
